sentences.text: The documents do not state the rate of interest for two-wheeler loans.
The in-force materials show a table entry for “Two Wheeler” under “RATE OF INTEREST,” but they do not give the rate itself.
The only APR value in the evidence is a superseded KFS entry of 17.07%.
